title: Generative peptide design with diffusion models
summary: Training a diffusion-based generative model for peptide design, extending the PepGLAD framework. I curated a much larger peptide–target complex dataset for training, fine-tuned on diverse subsets to raise the design success rate, and wired an external protein property predictor in as a constraint so that generation is steered toward peptides with real therapeutic relevance.

title: SYNBIP 2.0 — synthetic binding protein database
summary: Led the major update of SYNBIP, the reference database for synthetic binding proteins, addressing fragmented data, inconsistent standards, missing epitope information and narrow scaffold diversity. The update added 3D structures for 899 SBP–target complexes, expanded the SBP sequence space fivefold to 12,025, and catalogued over 16 million candidate scaffolds mined from the PDB and AlphaFold DB. Built with manual literature curation, protein–protein docking, structural alignment, AI and automated web-crawling pipelines.

title: Expanding the sequence space of synthetic binding proteins
summary: Applied the deep-learning design framework ProteinMPNN to synthetic binding proteins, sidestepping the dependence of site-directed mutagenesis on parent-protein structure. Designed 7,245 new sequences across 55 scaffolds and screened them in silico: the generated proteins showed improved solubility and thermal stability over known SBPs, and eight scaffolds turned out to be especially well suited to the method.

title: AI for pharmacology — industry research training
period: Sept. 2024 – present · China Resources Double Crane Pharmaceutical
summary: Evaluated and deployed machine-learning models for pharmacology tasks, providing technical support to early drug-discovery pipelines. Alongside the computational work I ran cell-based assays and mouse toxicity and efficacy studies, and carried out the statistical analysis backing clinical-trial applications.
